allowedWithoutEvent: frozen neutral prompt and UI shell
official provider documentation URLs in provider inventory
preflighted credentials for the fresh target or namespace-isolated shared target
ordinary shell, filesystem, browser, and test tools
mustRecordAsAssistanceEvent: implementation knowledge imported from another provider arm
credential repair after the timed window starts

hiding a gateway or poller in the neutral shell

checking existing account sessions without creating a project

writing schema, auth, data, function, or client integration code
